# jamfplatform_pro_category (Resource)

Manages a Jamf Pro category. Categories group policies, scripts, packages, and other Jamf Pro objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jamfplatform_pro_category" "applications" {
  name     = "Applications"
  priority = 9
}

resource "jamfplatform_pro_category" "security" {
  name     = "Security"
  priority = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Category display name. Must not be empty.
- `priority` (Number) Sort priority, 1–20. Lower numbers sort first.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Category ID assigned by Jamf Pro.
